notes.title: Decay of Logos is going FREE on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35184890/83419f8c93e480dc0f84dc2d2198c27e066d1051.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last post. It's hard to believe Decay of Logos was released almost 6 years ago.

We're grateful for all your support, a heartfelt thank you to everyone that joined us in this adventure.

Making games can be costly and we're ok with sharing that, despite breaking even, our game is not capable of supporting continuous development of updates and free DLC. 

We've decided to end our publishing deal so that we may better control the future of our game and its expansive world. We feel that it wouldn't be right to keep selling our game on Steam so we're making it free for everyone. Instead of taking it down, we're opening the world of Decay of Logos; [i]if you love something set it free[/i].

We're also considerably lowering the price on all consoles. If you wish to support future developments you can still do so by purchasing a [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/decay-of-logos-switch/]Switch[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP4034-CUSA11022_00-DECAYOFLOGOSUS00]Playstation[/url], or  [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/decay-of-logos/bwjn32tjmq44?ocid=periscope%2CAID2000142_aff_7593_1243925&tduid=%28ir__m1mnocpxjfhfsgunnek26rq0o22xjfw661kther200%29%287593%29%281243925%29%28te1Fq2FCseg-A3WDwWHU60uqLix6p1DqrQ%29%28%29&ranMID=24542&ranEAID=te1Fq2FCseg&ranSiteID=te1Fq2FCseg-A3WDwWHU60uqLix6p1DqrQ&epi=te1Fq2FCseg-A3WDwWHU60uqLix6p1DqrQ&irgwc=1&irclickid=_m1mnocpxjfhfsgunnek26rq0o22xjfw661kther200&activetab=pivot:reviewstab]Xbox[/url] version.

If you purchased our game recently and wish to get a refund be sure to use the appropriate Steam request: https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithPurchase

The store listing will be updated to FREE soon. This is not the end for DoL and we hope this gives anyone who's still on the fence a chance to explore its unique world. 

Special thanks to everyone that added to the game wiki and created guides to assist other players.

Until next time.

notes.title: Version 1.04 is Live! ( New input system )
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thank you for waiting for our latest update, we hope you enjoy the tweaks and additions we made based on your feedback. 

The main purpose of this update is to address existing input related [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/759570/discussions/0/2692512878712832418/]problems you might have been experiencing[/url]. We've replaced our old system with a new solution that should, hopefully, resolve gamepad related issues and general input problems under specific combinations of hardware. This new system also allowed us to finally add support for custom Gamepad and Keyboard mappings.



Please be sure to report any input related issues in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/759570/discussions/0/1735509916448716594/]1.04 Update[/url]

Make sure that the "Steam Input Game Settings" is no longer "forced off"; set it to default.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WV0FFsR.png[/img]

Make sure that the proper controller support is enabled.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QGnQGqj.png[/img]


We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you so you can expect additional patches in future.

Here's the change list for this update:
[list]
[*]Implemented a new input system
[*]Added support for custom keyboard and gamepad mappings
[*]Added additional Runestone information regarding leveling/progression
[*]Improved Runestone visibility at a distance
[*]Stinger(flying enemy) camera improvements
[*]Stingers range adjustment, it's easier to evade them by sprinting
[*]Tweaked Elk combat requirements, it will try to aid you sooner and more often
[*]Improved enemy variation and visibility (visual tweaks)
[*]Improved Low Stamina HUD feedback. (some players confuse low stamina with "input lag")
[*]Increased cancel window on a specific case. (non-cancelable animations often confused with "input lag")
[*]Improved auto-lock behaviour(e.g. falling enemies)
[*]Improved Parry detection/use
[*]Tweaked mini-boss Area of Effect damage radius(e.g. Lumberjack stomp)
[*]Tweaked "stagger" requirements on first level, not as unforgiving for new players
[*]Collision detection improvements
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Royal Guard sword to disappear after parrying
[*] Various small bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

Thank you!
The Decay of Logos Team

notes.title: Version 1.03 is live! ( WIN 7 support added )
notes.content:
Hi all!

Over the past weeks we've been working hard on fixing issues/bugs/features, and we're finally happy to announce that we now support Windows 7. Apologies for the late update but we also had to handle the Xbox and PS4 patch this week while also getting the Switch launch ready.
We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you so you can expect additional patches in future.
Here's the change list for this update:

- Windows 7 support
- Ultrawide and Super ultrawide screen support
- Xbox 360 controller fix
- Added an echo shell Read/Unread marker
- Various bug fixes
- Performance improvements
- "The Completionist" achievement fix

Thank you!
The Decay of Logos Team

notes.title: Version 1.01 is live!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Over the past couple of days we have been working hard on fixing issues/bugs and listening to players. We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you, so more patches are coming.

Right now, we are focusing on critical bugs and, after that we will work on some of the requested features, such as more extensive controller support and keyboard keybindings, Windows 7 support, among others.

Here's the change list for this patch:

- Elk control updated (easier to control)
- Elk navigation tweaked (Fixes Valis Sanctum various navigation issues, We will improving it even more)
- Pause performance impact and hangs should be fixed now
- Various inventory fixes, potions disappearing wrong spear behavior, multiplication of items etc
- Some environment fixes (various OOW falls)
- Pathos fall throw ground fix

Thank you!

notes.title: Out Now! Please Read!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Decay of Logos is out and we’re really excited!

Here's some notes:

OS:

- The game supports only Windows 10 for now. We’ll support more versions in future patches.

Controls:

- If you use a controller: We only support some controllers at the moment; Xbox One, Xbox 360 and PlayStation 4 has native support. If you’re using other controllers – please tell us which one you’re using in the community hub.
- Steam Input will be supported in the future to avoid the problems above.
- Keyboard keybindings will be added in future patches.

Issues/Reviews:
-This version has a lot of fixes compared with the reviewed version by the press

Shipping on various platforms with such a small team has been epic endeavor. Regardless of the bumpy launch, we hope everyone tries the game and enjoys what we worked so hard to create!

Thank you and happy gaming!
Amplify Creations
Rising Star Games

notes.title: Decay of Logos looks like Zelda: Breath of the Wild crossed with Dark Souls
notes.content:
Decay of Logos is a fantasy RPG with a strong whiff of Breath of the Wild and Dark Souls about it. More specifically, it blends the art style and exploration of the former with the exacting, slow burn combat of the latter. The Steam description proudly boasts that it has "minimal hand-holding", and most importantly, it features a "mystical elk" companion.

According to studio Amplify Creations, Decay of Logos is inspired by European folklore and J. R. R. Tolkien (All it's missing is a Summoning soundtrack). "The girl [ie the player character] and the Elk fatefully meet after her village is destroyed by one of the King’s sons," so reads a description on the game's website. "Battered and oblivious of the culprit behind the attack, the girl will not rest until she has her revenge. During her quest she will unveil secrets about the King and his sons, slowly realizing that all is not what it seems."

As the video below demonstrates, the game has a "high risk-reward battle system" with a variety of weapons both long and close range. All the Dark Souls trappings seem intact: you can parry, dodge and counter-attack, and the combat seems fairly reliant on stamina management. Likewise, the game boasts a "semi-open world", so expect something more in line with Lordran than Hyrule. 

It'll have a pretty austere approach to its RPG elements, too. Equipped gear will only be visible on the character model itself, and levelling is "fully automated and based on your play style", presumably in the manner of Skyrim.

Whatever the case, it's worth keeping an eye on: it releases August 30. And thankfully, its resemblance isn't so close to Breath of the Wild that it might compel people to smash their consoles in protest. Phew.

notes.title: Now available for wishlisting!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

It's great to finally join the Steam community. We're really happy to announce that we're getting close to our release date. We invite you all to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/759570/]Decay of Logos[/url] as we're going to start posting additional game information leading up to the release!

[b]Want to play before everyone else? [/b]
Let us know what part of the game you're most excited about for a chance to get a key before release. We’ll choose five winners after the weekend!

https://youtu.be/c6Yr7WIKlxQ

[b]What is this game all about?[/b]
Decay of Logos is a third-person action/adventure RPG with emphasis on player exploration with minimal hand-holding and challenging combat. You'll embark on a journey of revenge and betrayal set in motion by the destruction of our young adventurer's village at the hands of the Crimson Knights, only to find solace in your mystical elk companion as you battle the unforgiving foes that roam this once peaceful realm. You'll venture into ancient ruins and dungeons in search of its rewards in a quest to find the truth behind the attack of Ada’s home.
 
[b]When is it coming out?[/b]
2019, we're going to announce the date soon!

[b]Is it coming out on consoles?[/b]
Yes, around the same time on PS4, Xbox One, and Switch.

[b]Where can I learn more about the game?[/b]
We've been running a development blog since the early days of development, check it out [url=http://decayoflogos.com/development-blog/]HERE![/url] We post every Friday, be sure to follow us online.

[url=https://twitter.com/DecayofLogos]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/DecayOfLogos]Facebook[/url]

[b]What about a Wiki for all the completionnists our there?[/b]
We've got two, both will be flooded with information after the game is released! 

[b]Decay of Logos Wiki[/b]
[url=https://decayoflogos.gamepedia.com/Decay_of_Logos_Wiki]Gamepedia[/url]
[url=https://decayoflogos.wiki.fextralife.com/Decay+of+Logos+Wiki]Fextralife[/url]

Stay tuned, we have a lot more to share!
